checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and the itemized prices begin on page 1, so the disclosure is on the same page as the prices it accompanies.
The includesText lists arrangements conference, shelter of remains, notices, permits/authorizations, and coordination with cemetery, crematory or other third parties.
The list shows only the basic services fee as an overhead-type fee; no second mandatory facilities or staff fee text was seen.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the Embalming $795 price is on page 1, so they are on the same page.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or a closed-casket service without viewing.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation $1,595 to $1,945 range is on page 2, so they are on the same page.
Direct cremation is offered with purchaser-provided container and with fiberboard or unfinished wood options; no text says a casket is required.
The direct cremation charge is described as including cremation, and no separate crematory cash-advance charge is listed.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial all have their own priced lines, and no goods or services were seen mentioned only in a package or policy without a price.
No optional combination package was seen; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are not treated as packages.
The only require-by-cemetery language seen is the standard outer burial container statement about many cemeteries, which is prescribed wording.
No text claiming long-term delay of decomposition or protection from gravesite substances was seen.
No other wording that undercuts a required disclosure was seen, and disclosures appear in clear standard form.
